styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent cool-toned tech audio ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep navy blue #1E3A6E gradient backgrounds, clean white #FFFFFF panels, charcoal text #2D2D2D, tech-blue accent #3D8BFF with subtle cyan glow #35D6FF, and a single semantic red #E03C31 reserved only for before-state markers in comparison shots; modern geometric sans-serif typography with short Chinese copy wrapped in 「」; rounded-corner info cards, thin-line icons and thin rules; alternating deep-navy 3D geometric scenes and clean white infographic sections; soft cool studio key light with cyan rim glow on product shots, flat even light on infographic sections; stable product scale and placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 9 张 800×1200 详情页切片（相邻重叠 60px）拼合提炼。产品为入耳式真无线蓝牙耳机（带充电仓），与库内头戴式耳机模版（头戴式，另一源图）定位区分；源文件夹名与图片内容一致。已剥离：源图品牌字样与装饰英文、会员二维码与店铺角标、素材站水印、全部不可验证的具体数字与所有原文案，统一改为 {callout}/{selling_point} 文案槽由使用方填写；功能矩阵与兼容矩阵源图中重复的三行内容已去重为两行结构。对比镜的语义红 #E03C31 已纳入 style lock 防漂移。
